claims.text: Daily: zinc oxide 80 mg, copper 2 mg, vitamin C 500 mg, vitamin E 400 IU, lutein 10 mg/zeaxanthin 2 mg (or beta-carotene 15 mg or vitamin A 28,000 units in pts who have never smoked)
claims.quote: taking daily supplements of the following: - Zinc oxide 80 mg - Copper 2 mg - Vitamin C 500 mg - Vitamin E 400 IU - Lutein 10 mg/zeaxanthin 2 mg (or beta-carotene 15 mg or vitamin A 28,000 units for patients who have not smoked)

claims.text: Extensive drusen, pigment changes and/or geographic atrophy: lowers the risk of advanced AMD by 25%.
claims.quote: Patients with extensive drusen, pigment changes, and/or geographic atrophy can reduce the risk of developing advanced AMD by 25% by taking daily supplements

claims.text: Unilateral wet AMD: take them to protect the other eye
claims.quote: Patients with unilateral wet AMD should take the daily nutritional supplements that are recommended for dry AMD to reduce the risk of AMD-induced vision loss in the other eye.

claims.text: Current or former smokers: lutein/zeaxanthin instead of beta-carotene (lung cancer risk).
claims.quote: In patients who currently or formerly smoked, beta-carotene can increase the risk of lung cancer. Substitution of beta-carotene with lutein plus zeaxanthin has been shown to have comparable efficacy (1). Therefore, such a substitution should be considered in patients who currently or formerly smoked.

claims.text: Zinc raises the risk of genitourinary disorders
claims.quote: The zinc component of these supplements increases risk of genitourinary tract disorders.
